The weights are stored in matrices €2 that multiply the activations from the preceding layer to create the pre-activations at the subsequent layer. For example, the weight matrix €2; that computes the pre-activations at hy from the activations at hy has dimension 2 x 4. It is applied to the four hidden units in layer one and creates the inputs to the two hidden units at layer two. The biases are stored in vectors B, and have the dimension of the layer into which they feed. For example, the bias vector 3, is length three because layer hs contains three hidden units.
